BURSEVI:v10p316/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p316/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p316/r2.claim: Those who fear God, even if only somewhat, will soon remember, reflect, recognize the truth of the reminder, and believe.
BURSEVI:v10p316/r2.anchor: من شأنه أن يخشى الله حق خشيته أو من يشخى الله في الجملة فيزداد ذلك بالتذكير

BURSEVI:v10p316/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p316/r3.speaker: صاحب التفسير الكبير
BURSEVI:v10p316/r3.claim: The Great Commentary divides people on resurrection into certain believers, uncertain people open to persuasion, and determined deniers; the first two benefit from reminder.
BURSEVI:v10p316/r3.anchor: وفي التفسير الكبير الناس في أمر المعاد على ثلاثة أقسام منهم من قطع بصحته ومنهم من جوز وجوده

BURSEVI:v10p316/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p316/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p316/r5.claim: A report says a hypocrite refused to trade a date palm for one in Paradise, so Uthman gave the petitioner his own orchard and the verse was revealed.
BURSEVI:v10p316/r5.anchor: وروى أن من يخشى هو عثمان بن عفان رضي الله عنه وإلا شقى رجل من المنافقين

BURSEVI:v10p316/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p316/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p316/r6.claim: Two related stories contrast a man who chose eighty sheep over Paradise with an old woman who preferred Paradise to a hundred sheep for revealing Joseph's bones to Moses.
BURSEVI:v10p316/r6.anchor: ونظيره إن رجلا قضى النبي عليه السلام حاجة فقال ائتني بالمدينة

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417#2/r1.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417#2/r1.claim: Qatada says anyone who fears God remembers Him, while one who turns from the reminder out of disdain or hostility to it and its people is among the most wretched.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله : سيذكر من يخشى ويتجنبها الاشقى قال : والله ما خشي الله عبد قط الا ذكره

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r1.claim: The ف branches to the conclusion of earlier premises; the imperative asks for continued reminding, and the reminder is conveying the Quran.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r1.anchor:
فالفاء للتفريع على ما تقدم تفريع النتيجة على المقدمات .
والأمر : مستعمل في طلب الدوام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r2.claim: The object of remind is omitted to make the address general, meaning remind all people; the following verses show that those who fear will remember.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r2.anchor: ومفعول { فذكر } محذوف لقصد التعميم ، أي فذكر الناس

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r3.claim: The phrase if the reminder benefits all is parenthetical, not a condition limiting the command; one cannot predict who will benefit, as shown by the general Quranic call to warn.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r3.anchor: وهذا الاعتراض منظور فيه إلى العموم الذي اقتضاه حذف مفعول { فذكر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r4.claim: The conditional challenges certainty that everyone benefits: all are invited even though God knows that Abū Jahl will not believe, and events disclose what was decreed.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p284/r4.anchor: فأبو جهل مدعو للإيمان والله يعلم أنه لا يؤمن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās explains that the reminder benefits God's allies but not His enemies; Ibn ʿĀshūr says this resolves the apparent difficulty of the conditional without ellipsis.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r1.anchor: وهذا معنى قول ابن عباس : تنفع أوليائي ولا تنفع أعدائي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r2.speaker: الفراء
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r2.claim: Al-Farrāʾ and al-Naḥḥās propose supplying both sides of the condition, if it benefits and if it does not; Ibn ʿĀshūr says this is unnecessary.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r2.anchor: ولا حاجة إلى تقدير الفراء والنحاس : إن نفعت الذكرى وإن لم تنفع

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r3.claim: Yadhakkar is the assimilated form of yatadhakkar, with tāʾ changed to dhāl because their articulation points are close.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r3.anchor: وأصله : يتذكر ، فقلبت التاء ذالا لقرب مخرجيهما

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r4.claim: Whoever fears is a generic class, not one person; the pronoun stays singular because man is grammatically singular.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r4.anchor: من يخشى } : جنس لا فرد معين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r5.claim: Fear is left without an object: the receptive person reflects from a fearful disposition, weighs likely benefit and harm, and considers the evidence lest the warning come true.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r5.anchor: وقد نزل فعل { يخشى } منزلة اللازم فلم يقدر له مفعول

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r6.claim: Khashya means fear, has degrees, and distinguishes believers by rank, as in the earlier prayer that a person might remember or fear.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r6.anchor: والخشية : الخوف ، وتقدم في قوله تعالى : { لعله يتذكر أو يخشى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p286/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p286/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p286/r1.claim: Contrasting the one who fears with the most wretched implies the latter is heedless in delusion and pleasure, seeking no escape from misery.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p286/r1.anchor: ومقابلة { من يخشى } ب { الأشقى } تؤذن بأن { الأشقى } من شأنه أن لا يخشى

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90#3/r1.claim: Those who fear will take heed through the Qurʾān.

JISHUMI:v10p7378/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7378/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7378/r3.claim: Sayadhakkaru derives from sayatadhakkaru, with the tāʾ assimilated into the adjacent dhāl.
JISHUMI:v10p7378/r3.anchor: أصله [سيذتكر]، فأدغم التاء في الذال لقرب مخرجهما

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r5.claim: The one who fears God and a bad end will remember, reflect, and be led by thought to follow the truth.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r5.anchor: وينتفع بها { من يخشى } الله وسوء العاقبة

MUQATIL:87:8-13/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:87:8-13/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:87:8-13/r3.claim: Whoever fears God will remember and affirm His oneness; God forgives that person and does not take him to account.
MUQATIL:87:8-13/r3.anchor: سيوحد الله من يخشاه، يقول: من يخشاه غفر له، ولم يؤاخذه

NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#10/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#10/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#10/r1.claim: The one who fears God and a bad end will soon take heed and accept the reminder.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#10/r1.anchor: ﴿ سيذكر ﴾ سيتعظ ويقبل التذكرة ﴿ من يخشى ﴾ الله وسوء العاقبة

QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r1.speaker: أبو صالح عن ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r1.claim: A report from Ibn ʿAbbas says the verse was revealed about Ibn Umm Maktum.
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r1.anchor: فروى أبو صالح عن ابن عباس قال: نزلت في ابن أم مكتوم.

QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r2.speaker: الماوردي
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r2.claim: Al-Mawardi says people who hope may also benefit, but reminder reaches the fearful more powerfully, so the verse names fear while both fear and hope are included.
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r2.anchor: تذكرة الخاشي أبلغ من تذكرة الراجي فلذلك علقها بالخشية دون الرجاء

QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r3.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r3.claim: Al-Qushayri says to generalize the reminder even though it benefits those who fear, since the caller earns reward for inviting people.
QURTUBI-FULL:87:10/r3.anchor: وقيل: أي عمم أنت التذكير والوعظ، وإن كان الوعظ إنما ينفع من يخشى

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.claim: Al-Aʿla is Meccan and has nineteen verses; the Prophet loved it, recited it at Eid and Friday prayers with al-Ghashiya, sometimes on the same day.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.anchor: سورة الأعلى مكية وآياتها تسع عشرة

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.claim: The surah turns the entire cosmos into a sanctuary reverberating with praise and offers the Prophet good news of divine preservation and ease in his mission and affairs.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.anchor: وحق لرسول الله [ صلى الله عليه وسلم ] أن يحب هذه السورة وهي تحيل له الكون كله معبدا

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.claim: Its foundations are God's oneness as creator, divine revelation, and afterlife recompense, rooted in earlier scriptures; it also portrays the easy nature of the message, messenger, and community.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.anchor: وهي تتضمن الثابت من قواعد التصور الإيماني

QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r1.claim: The Prophet fulfills his duty by reminding; people then diverge in response and outcome, and God deals with them according to how they receive the reminder.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r1.anchor: فإذا نهض [ صلى الله عليه وسلم ] بهذا العبء فقد أدى ما عليه

QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r2.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r2.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r2.claim: The God-fearing person benefits from reminder because a living heart senses awe of God's anger and punishment, and knows the Creator will account for and justly repay good and evil.

RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r1.claim: People fall into those certain of resurrection, those who suspend judgment, and deniers; the first two groups fear, while deniers do not.
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r1.anchor: القسمان الأولان تكون الخشية حاصلة لهما ، وأما القسم الثالث فلا خشية له ولا خوف

RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r2.claim: One reading identifies the fearful as those who know God’s power, knowledge, and wisdom and therefore are certain of resurrection; 35:28 links fear to scholars.
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r2.anchor: الذي يخشى هو الذي يكون عارفا بالله وعارفا بكمال قدرته وعلمه وحكمته

RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r3.claim: Because inward fear is hidden from the Messenger, he must address everyone to reach those who will benefit from reminder.
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r3.anchor: صفات القلوب مما لا اطلاع لأحد عليها إلا الله سبحانه وجب على الرسول تعميم الدعوة

RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r4.claim: Alternatively, most people are hesitant rather than defiant, many opponents resist only outwardly, and warnings of Hell break their hearts; thus general reminder benefits most.
RAZI-FULL:v31p131#2/r4.anchor: وأكثر الخلق متوقفون غير معاندين والمعاند فيهم قليل

RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r1.claim: The future tense may promise certain remembrance, since God’s future acts are assured, or describe fearful people remembering later through reflection.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r1.anchor: السين في قوله : { سيذكر } يحتمل أن تكون بمعنى سوف يذكر وسوف من الله واجب

RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r2.claim: Unbelievers’ recollection is called remembrance because the proofs are so clear that their knowledge seems already present, then removed by imitation and obstinacy.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r2.anchor: لقوة الدلائل وظهورها كأن ذلك العلم كان حاصلا ، ثم إنه زال بسبب التقليد والعناد

RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r3.claim: One report says the verse was revealed about Uthman ibn Affan.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r3.anchor: قيل : نزلت هذه الآية في عثمان بن عفان

RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r4.claim: Another report says it was revealed about Ibn Umm Maktum.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132/r4.anchor: وقيل : نزلت في ابن أم مكتوم

STUDYQURAN:87:10/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r1.claim: Those certain of returning to God, and those who admit it without certainty, fear God; deniers of the return are the most wretched.
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r1.anchor: Those who are certain of the return to God and those who admit to it but are not certain of it are those who fear God

STUDYQURAN:87:10/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r2.claim: In relation to the preceding verse, the reminder benefits only those who fear God.
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r2.anchor: these verses imply that the reminder only benefits those who fear God

TAB-FULL:v24p317/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p317/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p317/r1.claim: Those who fear and dread God’s punishment will remember the admonition.
TAB-FULL:v24p317/r1.anchor: وقوله: {سيذكر من يخشى} [الأعلى: 10] يقول جل ثناؤه: سيذكر يا محمد إذ ذكرت الذين أمرتك بتذكيرهم

TABATABAI:87:14-16/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r4.claim: He rejects that reading because the next verse says that the God-fearing person will remember.
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r4.anchor: وفيه أنه يرده قوله تعالى بعده بلا فصل { سيذكر من يخشى }

TABATABAI:87:14-16/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r5.claim: The one who fears God and His punishment will remember and take admonition from the Qurʾān.
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r5.anchor: سيتذكر ويتعظ بالقرآن من في قلبه شيء من خشية الله وخوف عقابه

TABRISI:87:10-17/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:87:10-17/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:87:10-17/r1.claim: Those who fear God and His punishment will take admonition from the Qurʾān.
TABRISI:87:10-17/r1.anchor: سيتعظ بالقرآن من يخشى الله تعالى ويخاف عقابه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r1.claim: The God-fearing person will take heed from the Quran.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r2.speaker: عطاء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r2.claim: The person who will take heed is Uthman ibn Affan.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r2.anchor: قال عطاء: يريد (¬6) عثمان (¬7) بن عفان.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r3.speaker: الفراء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r3.claim: The verse was revealed about Ibn Umm Maktum.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r3.anchor: وقال الفراء: أنزلت في ابن أم مكتوم

WAHIDI-QT:87:10/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:87:10/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:87:10/r1.claim: The person who fears God will take heed.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r6.claim: The person who fears God will take admonition.

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:10:anmerkung/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:10:anmerkung/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:10:anmerkung/r1.claim: Q 79:26 is a parallel; Andrae identifies fear of the judging God, anxious watchfulness, and warning against heedlessness as traits of contemporary Christian monastic piety.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:10:anmerkung/r1.anchor: Wie Andrae (1932, 68 f.) herausgearbeitet hat, stellt die Furcht vor dem Richtergott

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r1.claim: The second stanza again addresses the messenger: he first praises God, perhaps with close followers, then speaks to a wider audience with an admonition that makes verse 6’s revelation public in purpose.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r1.anchor: Das zweite Gesätz beginnt wie das erste mit einem Aufruf an den Verkünder

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r4.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r4.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r4.claim: Verses 10–11 contrast good and bad responses to proclamation; verse 11 expands the bad response with a conventional warning of Hell, balanced by the promise to the good in verses 14–15.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r4.anchor: Auf den das zweite Gesätz einleitenden Aufruf folgt in V. 10.11 eine Antithese

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r5.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r5.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r5.claim: The passage forms a chiasm: the responses of good and bad in verses 10–11 correspond to their fates in verses 12–15, as in Q 92:5–11 and 14–21.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r5.anchor: Zusammen mit der an den Guten gerichteten Verheißung V. 14.15 ergibt sich eine chiastische Struktur

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r6.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r6.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r6.claim: The warning’s implied content includes fear of God, continued purification, invocation of God’s name, and prayer; verse 15 reprises verse 1’s call to recall the Creator’s favors.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r6.anchor: Erwähnt werden ständiges Bemühen um „Läuterung“ sowie Anrufung des Namens Gottes und Gebet

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r7.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r7.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r7.claim: Calls to the messenger can make a general appeal, with the messenger exemplary for each believer, as Robinson argues.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:9/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:9/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:9/r5.claim: Only those who fear God benefit from admonition; the wretched who reject God avoid it, and verse 12 says such avoidance leads to hell.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:9/r5.anchor: ondan ancak Allah’tan korkanların faydalanacağı, Allah’tan korkmayan, isyan ve günah batağına saplanmış olan bedbahtların ise ondan kaçacakları bildirilmiştir

ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r1.claim: The reminder will affect those disposed to fear God, or those who fear Him to some degree; the reminder deepens reflection until they recognize the truth and believe.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r1.anchor: سيذكر من يخشى أي سيذكر بتذكيرك من من شأنه أن يخشى الله تعالى حق خشيته

ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r2.speaker: الكوفيون
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r2.claim: Some grammarians read in as “when,” citing Qur'anic and hadith usages; other grammarians deny that sense and answer their examples through alternative analysis.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r2.anchor: وقيل إن إن بمعنى إذ كما في قوله تعالى وأنتم العلون إن كنتم مؤمنين

ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r3.speaker: عصام الدين
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r3.claim: ʿIsam al-Din says reminder should address what matters to each person: call unbelievers to faith before subsidiary duties, while reminding a sinful believer about prayer rather than faith.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r3.anchor: وقال عصام الدين المردا أن التذكير ينبغي أن يكون بما يكون مهما لمن له التذكير

ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r4.speaker: الفراء والنحاس والجرجاني والزهراوي
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r4.claim: Al-Farraʾ, al-Nahhas, al-Jurjani, and al-Zahrawi propose an ellipsis: remind whether or not the reminder benefits, as in a verse that mentions clothing protecting people from heat while omitting cold.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r4.anchor: وقال الفراء والنحاس والجرجاني والزهراوي الكلام على الأكتفاء والأصل فذكر أن نفعت الذكر وإن لم تنفع

ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r5.claim: The conditional presents no difficulty for those who reject the converse implication of a condition.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108/r5.anchor: والظاهر أن الذين لا يقولون بمفهوم المخافة سواء كان مفهوم الشرط أو غيره لا يشكل عليهم أمر هذه الآية

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r5.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r5.claim: The one who will take heed is the person who fears God.

BAYDAWI-FULL:87:9-12/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:9-12/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:9-12/r3.claim: The person who fears God will take heed by considering the reminder and recognizing its truth; the phrase includes both the spiritually certain and the hesitant.
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:9-12/r3.anchor: سيتعظ وينتفع بها من يخشى الله تعالى بأن يتأمل فيها فيعلم حقيقتها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r9.claim: People divide into those who accept treatment and those who do not; God has always known each person's outcome but leaves them unidentified as a trial and proof against them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r9.anchor: عالم بكل من القسمين جملة وأفرادا على التعيين ولم يزل عالما بذلك

BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r10.claim: Those with even an innate measure of fear will heed the reminder, because fear leads to every good and belongs to the felicitous.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r10.anchor: في جبلته نوع خشية , وهو السعيد

ABUHAYYAN:87:10/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:87:10/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:87:10/r1.claim: Only the fearful take heed: fear moves them to consider how to escape what they dread, and reflection leads to truth; these are scholars and believers according to their guidance.
ABUHAYYAN:87:10/r1.anchor: فإن الخوف حامل على النظر في الذي ينجيه مما يخافه

ALUSI:87:10/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:10/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI:87:10/r1.claim: The reminder will affect someone disposed to fear God, whether fully or generally; reflection leads to recognizing its truth and believing.
ALUSI:87:10/r1.anchor: أي سيذكر بتذكيرك من من شأنه أن يخشى الله تعالى حق خشيته أو من يخشى

BAGHAWI:87:10/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:87:10/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:87:10/r1.claim: The one who fears God will soon take heed.
BAGHAWI:87:10/r1.anchor: { سيذكر } سيتعظ ، { من يخشى } الله عز وجل

BAYDAWI:87:10/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:87:10/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:87:10/r1.claim: A person who fears God will reflect on the reminder, recognize its truth, and benefit from it; this includes both the knowledgeable and the hesitant.
BAYDAWI:87:10/r1.anchor: سيذكر من يخشى سيتعظ وينتفع بها من يخشى الله تعالى بأن يتأمل فيها فيعلم حقيقتها

BIQAI:87:10/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:10/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:10/r1.claim: People divide into those who accept treatment and those who do not; God has always known each group and individual but leaves them unspecified as a test, establishing proof by familiar means.
BIQAI:87:10/r1.anchor: إعلاماً بأنه سبحانه وتعالى عالم بكل من القسمين جملة

BIQAI:87:10/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:10/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:10/r2.claim: The future form is a promise that cannot fail, extending even to the subtlest forms of reminder, as the assimilation suggests.
BIQAI:87:10/r2.anchor: أي بوعد لا خلف فيه ولو على أخفى وجوه

BIQAI:87:10/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:10/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:10/r3.claim: The one who fears has some fear in his disposition and is destined for felicity: fear leads to good, acceptance, admonition, and lasting wholesome life in Paradise.
BIQAI:87:10/r3.anchor: وهو السعيد لما قدر له في نفسه من السعادة العظمى

BIQAI:87:10/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:10/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:10/r4.claim: Biqāʿī's exhortation includes gratitude for gifts such as intellect and the faculties of the heart, tongue, and other limbs.
BIQAI:87:10/r4.anchor: حاثاً على شكر الجوائح من العقل ونحوه

DURR:87:10/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:87:10/r1.speaker: قتادة
DURR:87:10/r1.claim: Qatada says everyone who fears God remembers His reminder; one who shuns it from disdain and hatred for it and its people is among the most wretched.
DURR:87:10/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله : { سيذكر من يخشى ويتجنبها الأشقى }

IBNASHUR:87:10/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:10/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:10/r1.claim: “Whoever fears” denotes a whole class, not a particular person; the verb’s singular agreement follows the singular form of man.
IBNASHUR:87:10/r1.anchor: جنس لا فرد معين أي سيتذكر الذين يخشون

IBNASHUR:87:10/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:10/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:10/r2.claim: The verb is treated as intransitive: those whose disposition includes fear anticipate harm and benefit, investigate their sources, and ponder the evidence lest the warning apply to them.
IBNASHUR:87:10/r2.anchor: منزلة اللازم فلم يقدر له مفعول

IBNASHUR:87:10/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:10/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:10/r3.claim: Khashya means fear, as in Ṭā Hā; fear has degrees, and believers differ according to their share of it.
IBNASHUR:87:10/r3.anchor: الخوف ، وتقدم في قوله تعالى :  { لعله يتذكر أو يخشى }

IBNATIYYA:87:10/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:87:10/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:87:10/r1.claim: Those who fear God and the afterlife will take heed; they are the learned and believers, each according to the guidance granted.
IBNATIYYA:87:10/r1.anchor: سيذكر من يخشى الله تعالى والدار الآخرة ، وهم العلماء والمؤمنون ، كل بقدر ما وفق

IBNKATHIR:87:10/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:87:10/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:87:10/r1.claim: The person who fears God and knows he will meet Him will take heed of Muhammad’s message.
IBNKATHIR:87:10/r1.anchor: من قلبه يخشى الله ويعلم أنه ملاقيه

KASHSHAF:87:10/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:10/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:87:10/r1.claim: The person who fears God and a bad end will reflect until led to truth and benefit from the reminder; the unreflective and unafraid are unlikely to accept it.
KASHSHAF:87:10/r1.anchor: فيقبل التذكرة وينتفع بها { مَن يخشى } الله وسوء العاقبة ، فينظر ويفكر

MAWARDI:87:10/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:87:10/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI:87:10/r1.claim: The one who fears is one who fears God; a hopeful person may also remember, but the reminder of the fearful is stronger, so fear is named although both fear and hope can prompt remembrance.
MAWARDI:87:10/r1.anchor: يعني يخشى الله ، وقد يتذكر من يرجوه ، إلا أن تذكرة الخاشي أبلغ من تذكرة الراجي فلذلك

NASAFI:87:10/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:87:10/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:87:10/r1.claim: The one who fears God and a bad end will take heed and accept the reminder.
NASAFI:87:10/r1.anchor: سيتعظ ويقبل التذكرة { مَن يخشى } الله وسوء العاقبة

QURTUBI:87:10/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:10/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI:87:10/r1.claim: The one who fears is someone mindful of and afraid of God.

QURTUBI:87:10/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:10/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI:87:10/r2.claim: Abū Ṣāliḥ reports from Ibn ʿAbbās that this verse was revealed about Ibn Umm Maktūm.
QURTUBI:87:10/r2.anchor: فروى أبو صالح عن ابن عباس قال : نزلت في ابن أم مكتوم

QURTUBI:87:10/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:10/r3.speaker: الماوردي
QURTUBI:87:10/r3.claim: Al-Māwardī says a hopeful person may also remember, but reminder affects the fearful more strongly, so the verse names fear even though both fear and hope are involved.
QURTUBI:87:10/r3.anchor: الماوردي : وقد يذكر من يرجوه ، إلا أن تذكرة الخاشي أبلغ من تذكرة الراجي

QURTUBI:87:10/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:10/r4.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI:87:10/r4.claim: Al-Qushayrī says the Prophet should admonish everyone; even if only the fearful benefit, he earns the reward of calling people.
QURTUBI:87:10/r4.anchor: وقيل : أي عمم أنت التذكير والوعظ ، وإن كان الوعظ إنما ينفع من يخشى

RAZI:87:10/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r1.claim: People fall into three groups about resurrection: those certain of it, those who consider it possible, and those who deny it; the first two can fear it.
RAZI:87:10/r1.anchor: منهم من قطع بصحته ، ومنهم من جوز وجوده ولكنه غير قاطع فيه

RAZI:87:10/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r2.claim: On one reading, the fearful person knows God’s power, knowledge, and wisdom and is certain of resurrection, as in the statement that only knowledgeable servants fear God.
RAZI:87:10/r2.anchor: الذي يخشى هو الذي يكون عارفا بالله وعارفا بكمال قدرته وعلمه وحكمته

RAZI:87:10/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r3.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r3.claim: This identifies who benefits from the reminder; since only God can see inward fear, the Messenger must address everyone to reach those who will benefit.
RAZI:87:10/r3.anchor: صفات القلوب مما لا اطلاع لأحد عليها إلا الله سبحانه وجب على الرسول تعميم الدعوة

RAZI:87:10/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r4.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r4.claim: On another reading, believers and non-hostile doubters fear; doubters are the majority, and together with the knowledgeable they greatly outnumber the hostile deniers.
RAZI:87:10/r4.anchor: الخشية حاصلة للعاملين وللمتوقفين غير المعاندين وأكثر الخلق متوقفون غير معاندين

RAZI:87:10/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r5.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r5.claim: Many adversaries resist only verbally; inwardly persistent deniers are exceedingly rare.
RAZI:87:10/r5.anchor: فأما المعاند في قلبه بينه وبين نفسه فذلك مما لا يكون أو إن كان فهو في غاية الندرة

RAZI:87:10/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r6.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r6.claim: Warnings of the greater Fire and its condition of neither death nor life break hearts, so most people will listen and benefit; abandoning much good for little evil is itself a great evil.
RAZI:87:10/r6.anchor: انكسر قلبه فلابد وأن يستمع وينتفع أغلب الخلق في أغلب الأحوال

RAZI:87:10/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r7.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r7.claim: Although knowledge is usually called remembering only after it was acquired and forgotten, clear proofs make the knowledge seem already present and then removed by imitation and obstinacy.
RAZI:87:10/r7.anchor: لقوة الدلائل وظهورها كأن ذلك العلم كان حاصلا ، ثم إنه زال بسبب التقليد والعناد

RAZI:87:10/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r8.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r8.claim: The future particle may express a promise whose fulfillment from God is certain, as in “We shall make you recite, and you will not forget.”
RAZI:87:10/r8.anchor: السين في قوله : { سيذكر } يحتمل أن تكون بمعنى سوف يذكر

RAZI:87:10/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r9.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r9.claim: Alternatively, the God-fearing person will remember after some time through reflection and deliberation.
RAZI:87:10/r9.anchor: إن من خشي الله فإنه يتذكر وإن كان بعد حين بما يستعمله من التدبر والنظر

RAZI:87:10/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r10.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r10.claim: One report identifies the verse’s occasion as ʿUthmān b. ʿAffān.
RAZI:87:10/r10.anchor: قيل نزلت هذه الآية في عثمان بن عفان

RAZI:87:10/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:10/r11.speaker: author
RAZI:87:10/r11.claim: Another report identifies the verse’s occasion as Ibn Umm Maktūm.
RAZI:87:10/r11.anchor: وقيل : نزلت في ابن أم مكتوم

TAB:87:10/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:87:10/r1.speaker: author
TAB:87:10/r1.claim: When Muhammad gives the commanded reminder, the person who fears God and His punishment will take heed.
TAB:87:10/r1.anchor: سيذّكّر يا محمد إذا ذكّرت الذين أمرتك بتذكيرهم من يخشى الله

TAB:87:10/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:87:10/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB:87:10/r2.claim: Qatada says that anyone who fears God remembers Him; no servant has feared God without taking heed.
TAB:87:10/r2.anchor: عن قتادة ،   قوله :  فَذَكّرْ إنْ نَفَعَت الذّكْرى سَيَذّكّرُ مَنْ يَخْشى

QASHANI:87:6-10/r8.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:87:6-10/r8.speaker: author
QASHANI:87:6-10/r8.claim: Those who fear remember and benefit: they have tender hearts, sound natures, and receptivity to the reminder's light and purity.
QASHANI:87:6-10/r8.anchor: من كان لين القلب سليم الفطرة مستعدا لقبوله

QUSHAYRI:v3p414/r19.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p414/r19.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p414/r19.claim: The one who fears God and His punishment will remember.

NAHHAS:v5p205/r15.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p205/r15.speaker: الحسين بن وقاد
NAHHAS:v5p205/r15.claim: Al-Husayn ibn Waqad identifies the one who fears as Abu Bakr.
NAHHAS:v5p205/r15.anchor: قال الحسين بن وقاد هو أبو بكر الصديق

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p271/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p271/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p271/r1.claim: The Prophet should not pursue the obdurate or force the message: he is to remind when useful, while the fearful heed it and the wretched evade it and face their fate.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p271/r1.anchor: The Prophet (sws) is directed not to go after the stubborn and the obdurate.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r6.claim: The verses distinguish those who heed the warning from those who evade it; their rejection reflects their own condition, not a flaw in the message or preacher.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r1.claim: Evaders treat this life as all that exists and fear no Hereafter; they face eternal Fire, neither living nor dying, and will wish in vain for death.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r1.anchor: They regard this life to be all that there is.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r2.claim: Those who preserve nature's God-given light recognize a prophet's call, or awaken when prompted; where that light is extinguished, only the Judgement trumpet can awaken them.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r2.anchor: people in whom this light has been totally extinguished

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r9.claim: Only the fearful take heed: fear prompts reflection on escape, and reflection leads to truth; these include scholars and believers in differing measure.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r9.anchor: سيذكر من يخشى: أي لا يتذكر بذكراك إلا من يخاف، فإن الخوف حامل على النظر

DURR-FULL:v8p483/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r7.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r7.claim: Whoever fears God is surely reminded; only the wretched shun the reminder out of disdain for it and its people.
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r7.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله: {سيذكر من يخشى ويتجنبها الأشقى} قال: والله ما خشي الله عبد قط إلا ذكره

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p470/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p470/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p470/r4.claim: Those who fear God and the Hereafter will heed the reminder, while the one destined for misery rejects it and faces the Fire.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p470/r4.anchor: سيذكر من يخشى الله والدار الآخرة، وهم العلماء والمؤمنون كل بقدر ما وفق

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r17.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r17.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r17.claim: The one who fears God will heed the reminder; hopeful people may also remember, but fear produces the stronger response.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r17.anchor: وقد يتذكر من يرجوه , إلا أن تذكرة الخاشي أبلغ من تذكرة الراجي

TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r3.claim: The benefit condition is real: reminders are not futile and benefit the fearful by inclining them toward truth.
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r3.anchor: فإنها إذا لم تنفع كانت لغوا وهو تعالى يجل عن أن يأمر باللغو

THALABI:v10p184/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p184/r7.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p184/r7.claim: The Prophet should admonish with Quran where it benefits; the one who fears God will take heed.
THALABI:v10p184/r7.anchor: فذكر عظ بالقرآن إن نفعت الذكرى التذكر سيذكر سيتعظ من يخشى الله
